name: What steps are involved in repairing interior storm damage?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in repairing interior storm damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Addressing storm damage requires stabilizing the home and repairing compromised interior surfaces. Typical repairs include removing water-damaged drywall, replacing swollen baseboards, fixing leaking framing gaps, and repainting affected ceilings. Because storm impacts can be deceptively deep, drying out wall cavities thoroughly before hanging new sheetrock is critical to prevent mold growth. Documenting visible damage with detailed photos and keeping receipts for emergency stabilization work makes insurance claims and repair estimates run much smoother.
acceptedAnswer.description: Storm repairs involve drying the structure, removing compromised drywall and trim, rebuilding framing if necessary, and refinishing surfaces with fresh texture and paint.
